notes.title: Ver.1.1.0 Update Information
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43676149/f5b98abc2d4af3af9bd6efdb06fd8beebe0137a2.png[/img]
Below are the details for the version update.

[h2][b]Changes from Version 1.0.9:[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Adjusted the breakthrough difficulty by adding checkpoints along the way where the chasing characters appear
[*] Adjusted the breakthrough difficulty by changing the speed of the chasing characters in several locations
[*] Adjusted the direction of the player when returning to the checkpoints to avoid being captured again immediately after restarting from a checkpoint.
[*] After watching the game ending, players will be able to select “Start Game” and choose to return to the checkpoint immediately before the ending.
[*] An option to display a viewpoint marker of a small dot in the screen center is added to reduce the motion sickness that may be caused by the frequent screen shaking
[*] A notification icon is added to the Album button on Option screen when there is a new photo.
[*] Adjustment to the game opening cutscene of the sinking ship
[*] Other minor changes
[/list]

[h2][b]●Bug Fixes[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed the issue where the third controllable character is unable to move ahead in a tilted position in the area where the barrel falls from above the character.
[*] Fixed the issue where the third controllable character is unable to move ahead in a tilted position in a specific area in the stage where the character’s paint is scattered.
[*] Other minor bug fixes
[/list]

We hope you continue to enjoy playing “Gift” in the future.

notes.title: Version 1.0.9 Update Information
notes.content:
We have implemented the following update for the Windows and Mac versions of 'Gift'.

Changes from Version 1.0.8:
● Addressed an issue where arriving at a specific location at a certain time would cause an unintended tilt state, making progression extremely difficult. This has been corrected to ensure the intended tilt state.

We appreciate your continued support of 'Gift'.

notes.title: Version 1.0.8 Update Information for Mac
notes.content:
We have implemented the following updates for the Mac version of "Gift":

Changes from Version 1.0.7:
● We have addressed an issue where the red floor with logs on it could become indestructible, leading to game progression being blocked.
● Other minor bug fixes have been made.

The content for this update is the same as the previously released Windows version 1.0.8.
We sincerely apologize for the delay in updating this version compared to the Windows version.

Thank you very much for your understanding and continued support of "Gift".

notes.title: Version 1.0.8 Update Information
notes.content:
We have implemented the following updates for the Windows version of "Gift":

Changes from Version 1.0.7:
● We have addressed an issue where the red floor with logs on it could become indestructible, leading to game progression being blocked.
● Other minor bug fixes have been made.

Due to the urgency of the updates, we are applying them as soon as verification is completed on each platform. We are also quickly addressing the Mac version and will update it accordingly. We appreciate your understanding.

Thank you for your continued support of "Gift".
